column1: # The reasons an element is refused when it is lowered (GVEC_Lower_Reason), in the order of the enum.
# Columns, separated by TAB: constant (after GVEC_LOWER_), name (gvec_lower_reason_string), lifted by (the phase or shape-family id whose work draws it, or 'never'), what is refused, why.
# tools/lower/gen-reasons.py reads this and writes documentation/refusals.md and src/codec/svg/lower/lower_reason_table.h; `make check-test-data` fails if either is stale.

column4: An elliptical arc (`A`, `a`) in path data.
column5: The arc is the shape family's exact primitive. Converting it to Bézier curves would approximate it, so the element is refused until the primitive is lowered.

column4: `rect`, `circle` or `ellipse` that would be painted.
column5: These are the shape family's exact named shapes. Drawing them as polygons or curves would approximate them.

column4: A `linearGradient` or `radialGradient` paint.
column5: Gradients are lowered in V4.

column4: A `pattern` paint.
column5: Patterns are lowered in V6.

column4: `clip-path` naming a `clipPath` or a basic shape.
column5: Clips are lowered in V4. A reference that names nothing is not a refusal: SVG 2 treats the property as if it were not specified.

column4: `mask` naming anything, including an element the document does not have.
column5: Masks are lowered in V6.

column4: An `image` element that would be seen.
column5: Images are lowered in V6.

column4: `filter` naming anything, including an element the document does not have.
column5: Filters are lowered in V8.

column4: A `text` element.
column5: Text is lowered in V7, through the font library's layout and glyph runs.

column4: `mix-blend-mode` other than `normal`.
column5: Blend modes are lowered in V6.

column4: `context-fill` or `context-stroke` as a paint.
column5: They name the paint of a marker's or a `use`'s context. Those in a marker or in a `use`'s referent are lowered; one anywhere else is not.

column4: A colour the shape waist cannot carry: a space it has no gamut for, or a colour that needs a conversion the waist does not define.
column5: Converting would approximate the colour. The colour is reported where it was read, and the element using it is refused.

column4: A `foreignObject` that would be seen.
column5: Its content is not SVG; this library does not render it.

column4: A `use` of an element of another document, or of a `data:` URI.
column5: Nothing is fetched, ever (the load never reads outside its input).

column4: A `use` on a reference cycle.
column5: The cycle was reported when the document was loaded; the use that closes it is not instantiated.

column4: A `use` that instantiates more elements than `max_reference_expansion` allows.
column5: Reported when the document was loaded; the use is not instantiated.

column4: A limit of the document, the lowering or `shape-scene` was reached: the drawing nests deeper than `max_depth` once references are expanded, a coordinate is past the waist's range, or a store, list or scene limit was met.
column5: The element is refused rather than truncated.

column4: A property of the element has no value that can be used (the style layer reports it where it was read).
column5: The element cannot be drawn without its value.

column4: A `transform` whose percentages are of a bounding box (`transform-box: fill-box` or `stroke-box`) on an element that has a percentage.
column5: The bounding box is computed with the exact primitives.

column4: `audio`, `video`, `canvas` or `iframe` that would be seen.
column5: This library renders none of them.

column4: A `vector-effect` other than `none` and `non-scaling-stroke` on an element that would be stroked.
column5: The other values (`fixed-position`, `non-scaling-size`, `non-rotation`, `screen`) are not part of SVG 2's rendering model for a static document.
